correctness.rationale: The weight-four reduced Świątkowski basis comprises c_q=binom(10,q)4^q binom(28-q,4-q), with dimensions (20475,117000,234000,192000,53760). Inspected verify.py implements all basis monomials and each boundary column over F2 using exact XOR bitset elimination, with claimed boundary ranks (20474,96509,136963,53759) under two reference choices. Independent union-find over the 20475 edge-multisets and 117000 q=1 incidences gives rank d1=20474; independent binomial Gal coefficient gives chi=-765 and claimed Betti formula reproduces it. An Cor 3.18 establishes top F2 class dimension one. The large middle-boundary eliminations were reviewed at code level but NOT executed afresh; this is a computational verification limit, not an imaginary independent rerun.
